name: Weinbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Weinbach (a white axe on red above a vine leaf on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Weinbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weinbach arms — axe and vine leaf
